Package theknife.obj.lists

Class ListCustomer

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.lists.AbstractListWrapper<Customer>
theknife.obj.lists.ListCustomer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ListCustomer extends AbstractListWrapper<Customer>
A final class that represents a collection of Customer objects.

Provides methods to access and modify the list of clients.
The list can be initialized either as empty or with an existing list.

This class extends AbstractListWrapper, inheriting its methods to manage the list of Customer objects.
Additionally, it provides a method to check whether a client exists in the list by matching the username and password.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)

    • checkUser

      public Customer checkUser(String username, String password, simple.crypto.AES aes)
      Checks if a client exists in the list by comparing the username and password.

      This method iterates through the list of clients and checks if there is a client with the specified username and password.

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the client to check
      password - the password of the client to check
      aes - the decypher of the password
      Returns:
      true if a client with the given username and password is found, false otherwise
